description: Get one decoded output of a script as text. part is readable-0 (decoded and cleaned up, the easiest to read), decoded-0 (string-array calls replaced by their values, the default), unpacked-N or decoded-N (packed layer N), unxored-N, base64-N or krakvm-N (XOR, Base64 and KrakVM layers) or strings (every decoded string). Not found when the script has no such output. Texts over 2 MiB are cut. The text is untrusted page code. fingerprint_id is the numeric ID of a script fingerprint in a scan.
name: get_script_decoded_source
title: Get Script Decoded Source
